knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# PART A - IMPORTING AND INSPECTING A CSV
```{r}
# A1
emp_df <- read.csv("employees.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# A2
str(emp_df)
head(emp_df, 5)
summary(emp_df)
```

```{r}
# A3
nrow(emp_df)
ncol(emp_df)
sapply(emp_df, class)
```

```{r}
# A4
mean(emp_df$salary, na.rm = TRUE)
max(emp_df$age, na.rm = TRUE)
table(emp_df$department)
```

# PART B - CREATING DATA FRAMES
```{r}
# B1
new_hires <- data.frame(
  emp_id = c(21, 22, 23),
  name = c("Uma", "Victor", "Wen"),
  department = c("HR", "IT", "Sales"),
  sex = c("F", "M", "F"),
  age = c(28, 37, 33),
  salary = c(45000, 83000, 60000),
  years_service = c(2, 9, 6),
  rating = c(3, 4, 5),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# B2
emp_all <- rbind(emp_df, new_hires)
dim(emp_all)
```

```{r}
# B3
emp_all$bonus <- round(emp_all$salary * 0.05)
```

# PART C - SUBSETTING
```{r}
# C1
emp_all[1:5, c("name", "salary")]
```

```{r}
# C2
emp_all[emp_all$salary > 70000, ]
```

```{r}
# C3
subset(emp_all, department == "IT" & years_service >= 5,
select = c(name, years_service, salary))
```

```{r}
# C4
idx <- which(emp_all$age > 50)
print(idx)
print(emp_all$name[idx])
```

```{r}
# C5
drop_cols <- match(c("emp_id", "bonus"), names(emp_all))
print(emp_all[1:3, -drop_cols])
```

```{r}
# C6
print(emp_all$salary[emp_all$name == "Mia"])
```

# PART D - FACTORS
```{r}
# D1
emp_all$department <- factor(emp_all$department)
emp_all$sex <- factor(emp_all$sex)
levels(emp_all$department)
levels(emp_all$sex)
```

```{r}
# D2
table(emp_all$department)
table(emp_all$department, emp_all$sex)
```

```{r}
# D3
emp_all$rating_level <- factor(emp_all$rating, levels = 1:5,
labels = c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very Good", "Excellent"),
ordered = TRUE)
table(emp_all$rating_level)
```

```{r}
# D4
for (d in levels(emp_all$department)) {
m <- round(mean(emp_all$salary[emp_all$department == d], na.rm = TRUE))
print(paste(d, m))
}
```

# PART E - CONDITIONAL STATEMENTS
```{r}
# E1
emp_all$salary_band <- ifelse(emp_all$salary >= 70000, "High",
                       ifelse(emp_all$salary >= 50000, "Medium", "Low"))
print(table(emp_all$salary_band))
```

```{r}
# E2
emp_all$level <- ifelse(emp_all$years_service >= 8, "Senior", "Junior")
print(table(emp_all$level))
```

```{r}
# E3
raise_pct <- function(rating) {
  if (rating == 5) {
    0.10
  } else if (rating == 4) {
    0.07
  } else if (rating == 3) {
    0.04
  } else {
    0
  }
}
emp_all$raise <- sapply(emp_all$rating, raise_pct)
emp_all$new_salary <- round(emp_all$salary * (1 + emp_all$raise))
print(head(emp_all[, c("name", "rating", "raise", "new_salary")], 5))
```

```{r}
# E4
total <- sum(emp_all$new_salary)
if (total < 1600000) {
  print("Budget OK")
} else {
  print("Over budget")
}
print(total)
```

# PART F - CONDITIONAL STATEMENTS
```{r}
# F1
sort(emp_all$salary, decreasing = TRUE)[1:5]
sort(emp_all$name)[1:5]
```

```{r}
# F2
by_salary <- emp_all[order(emp_all$salary, decreasing = TRUE), ]
print(head(by_salary[, c("name", "department", "salary")], 5))
```
